title: SOCCER | Postgame Press Conference at Notre Dame (NCAA Tournament) - 11/27/26
text: but obviously really kind of fought back in that second half and made it much closer than maybe it was on paper. Yeah. Congrats to Notre Dame. I mean they're phenomenal team. And we told the team ultimately at the end of this tournament, there's only one team that's going to be happy and everyone goes out at some point. I hate that our journey ended now, but now what a season. Really proud of the girls, the way they banded together, the way they work for each other and competed. And to make it into the tournament, to make it to the second round is a massive achievement. And, you know, it's something that we're really proud of and excited to build on. You've talked a lot over the season about Jenny and what she's been able to do for you. She ends her career with a couple records and pretty high up in the record book here at Mississippi State. Just kind of what has she meant to this team? Yeah, we'll miss her. Not only is she phenomenal goalkeeper, she's just a great person and a real professional in the college ranks. The way she approaches the job of goaltending. It's like I've never seen before the film study. The. I mean, she's as detail oriented a person I've ever met. And no surprise, she's been as good as she's been for us this year. But certainly wish her the best and we'll miss her. You got some of the younger players some time there at the end. This is a really young team. What does that make you excited for going into next year? Yeah. You know and a lot of those girls haven't featured much this year. But they're very talented. And you know, I was glad to be able to get them in and get them some some NCAA tournament experience because that's the that's the the hope for this program that we continue year in and year out to be an NCAA tournament team and ideally going on deep runs. Thank you coach.
